model_definitions.correct_interpretation: Identifies spatial bounding box around supported injury classes ('wound', 'cut', 'bruise', 'abrasion', 'laceration'). Absence of box does NOT mean no injury exists.
Calculates global injury type likelihood across 4 categories.
Delineates lesion region within ROI box and computes percentage of affected area.
Visualizes model attention focus in target layer 'conv_head'. Not a clinical segmentation boundary.
